question: The Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi (Amendment) Bill, 2023 establishes the National Capital Civil Services Authority, which consists of the Chief Minister, Chief Secretary of Delhi and _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Principal Home Secretary of Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi (Amendment) Bill, 2023 **establishes the National Capital Civil Services Authority.
 
• The National Capital Civil Services Authority consists of three members: the Chief Minister of Delhi, the Chief Secretary of Delhi, and the **Principal Home Secretary of Delhi**.
 
• This authority is responsible for making recommendations to the Lieutenant Governor regarding matters concerning transfers and postings of officers and employees of the Delhi government.
 
• The inclusion of the Principal Home Secretary ensures that administrative and internal security aspects are considered in decision-making.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi (Amendment) Bill, 2023 aims to enhance the governance framework of Delhi by clearly defining the roles and responsibilities of various authorities.
 
• The bill seeks to strike a balance between the powers of the elected government of Delhi and the central government represented by the Lieutenant Governor.
 
• It addresses issues related to administrative efficiency and the effective implementation of policies in the National Capital Territory.
 
• This amendment is part of ongoing efforts to streamline the governance of Delhi and ensure better coordination between various levels of government.
 
• By including key officials in the National Capital Civil Services Authority, the bill aims to provide a more structured and accountable mechanism for administrative decisions.
